raw.title: Add dates parsing module
raw.description: Add a new module `src/todo/dates.py` with function `parse_due(text, today)` that parses due date strings. It accepts 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'today', 'tomorrow', and '+Nd' (N days after today, N a positive integer). Anything else raises ValueError. The function signature is parse_due(text: str, today: datetime.date) -> datetime.date.

must_cover: parse_due with YYYY-MM-DD format
parse_due with 'today'
parse_due with 'tomorrow'
parse_due with '+Nd' format
parse_due with invalid input raises ValueError

raw.title: Add due date to Task model
raw.description: Modify `src/todo/models.py` to add a `due` field to the Task class. The field is a datetime.date or None, defaulting to None. The `to_dict()` method stores it as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' string or None; `from_dict()` turns it back into a date, and a dict with no 'due' key loads as None. Add `Task.is_overdue(today)` method that returns True only if the task is not done, has a due date, and the due date is before today. The method signature is is_overdue(self, today: datetime.date) -> bool.

must_cover: Task with due date field
Task.to_dict() stores due date as ISO string
Task.from_dict() loads due date from ISO string
Task.from_dict() loads None when no 'due' key
Task.is_overdue() returns True when task is overdue
Task.is_overdue() returns False when task is not overdue
existing_tests_to_update: test_roundtrip() must be updated to include due field

raw.title: Update service to handle due dates
raw.description: Modify `src/todo/service.py` to support due dates in the `TodoService.add()` method. The method signature is `add(self, title, tags=(), due=None, today=None)`. When `due` is provided, it should be parsed with `parse_due()` (today defaults to `datetime.date.today()`). The parsed date is saved on the task. The `due` parameter is a string that gets parsed with `parse_due()`.

must_cover: TodoService.add() with due date parameter
TodoService.add() with due date parsed correctly
TodoService.add() with due=None defaults to None
existing_tests_to_update: test_add_complete() must be updated to handle due dates

raw.title: Add overdue query functionality
raw.description: Add a new function `overdue(tasks, today)` to `src/todo/query.py` that returns overdue tasks sorted by due date, with ties broken by id. The function signature is `overdue(tasks: list, today: datetime.date) -> list`. Overdue tasks are those that are not done, have a due date, and the due date is before today.

must_cover: overdue() returns only overdue tasks
overdue() sorts by due date first, then by id
overdue() returns empty list when no tasks are overdue

raw.title: Update formatting to show overdue tasks
raw.description: Modify `src/todo/formatting.py` to update `format_task(task, today=None)` function. When `today` is given and the task is overdue, append ' (overdue)' to the line. Without `today`, output is unchanged. The function signature is `format_task(task, today=None) -> str`.

must_cover: format_task() without today parameter unchanged
format_task() with today parameter and overdue task shows '(overdue)'
format_task() with today parameter and non-overdue task unchanged

raw.title: Update CLI to support due dates and overdue listing
raw.description: Modify `src/todo/cli.py` to support due dates in the 'add' command and overdue filtering in the 'list' command. The 'add' command accepts `--due TEXT` parameter which is parsed with `parse_due()`. The 'list' command accepts `--overdue` flag which shows only tasks overdue as of today, formatted with the overdue marker. The 'add' command signature is `add --due TEXT` and 'list' command signature is `list --overdue`.

must_cover: CLI 'add' command with --due parameter
CLI 'list' command with --overdue flag
CLI 'list' command without --overdue flag works normally
existing_tests_to_update: test_add_list() must be updated to test due dates
